Name: Pig Girl Caroline
Author: YukoValis
Description:
Well here it is.  The last of the large animals for your farm.  I decided to go with caroline because I wanted to keep her and abigail close.
This one wasn't my jam compared to the rest, but I got a lot of requests for it so I did my best.
Content Patcher version is included
NOTE: Nothing has changed with this sprite since 1.3, so it should still work.
